title: Austin Budget: 5-Year Economic Forecast
meeting_type: Austin City Council Budget Work Session
summary:
*   City officials met for a dedicated budget work session to discuss Austin's financial future.
*   A key presentation covered the city's current economic outlook and trends.
*   Discussions focused on a detailed five-year financial forecast for Austin's general operating fund.
*   This session served as strategic planning for future budget development, with no immediate policy votes or public hearings scheduled.

AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL BUDGET WORK SESSION 
 
Wednesday, April 20, 2011 
 
The Austin City Council will convene at 9:30 AM on 
Wednesday, April 20, 2011 at Austin City Hall, Boards and Commissions 
301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX 
 
 
 
Mayor Lee Leffingwell 
Mayor Pro Tem Mike Martinez 
Council Member Chris Riley, Place 1 
Council Member Randi Shade, Place 3 
Council Member Laura Morrison, Place 4 
Council Member William Spelman, Place 5 
Council Member Sheryl Cole, Place 6 
 
For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The City Council will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code 
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters, 
to discuss or take action on a “competitive matter” of Austin Energy as provided for 
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda. 
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this agenda.  
 
Reading and Action on Consent Agenda 
Action on the Following:  
Ordinances / Resolutions / Motions - 
All of the following items may be acted upon by one motion. No separate discussion or 
action on any of the items is necessary unless desired by a Council Member. 
 
 
9:30 AM – City Council Convenes 
 
Financial and Administrative Services 
 
1. Presentation and discussion on the City's Economic Outlook and Five Year Financial 
Forecast for the General Fund. 
 
Adjourn
